ticker: US East Coast faces severe Thanksgiving storm and power cuts.
SAP weighs massive 10,000 job cuts in AI shift.
Kuwait blames Iran for fatal drone strike on facility.
Former Spanish central bank head named ECB chief.
India moves toward strict packaged water surveillance.

articles.headline: SAP Weighs 10,000 Job Cuts in AI Restructuring
articles.brief: German software giant SAP is reportedly considering at least 10,000 job cuts as part of a broader corporate restructuring focused on artificial intelligence capabilities, according to Bloomberg reports.

articles.headline: IBM Ends H-1B and Green Card Sponsorship in Consulting
articles.brief: Technology major IBM has decided to halt work visa and green card sponsorships for most roles within its consulting division, affecting employees who must relocate or leave by the end of 2026.

articles.headline: Indian Rupee Bulls Return While Rupiah Bears Strengthen
articles.brief: The Indian rupee has seen bulls return for the first time in 18 months, contrasting sharply with Indonesian rupiah bears who have tightened their grip amid shifting regional currency market dynamics.

articles.headline: Ex-Spain Central Bank Head Named Next ECB Chief
articles.brief: The former head of Spain's central bank has officially been nominated as the next chief of the European Central Bank, stepping into the prominent monetary policy role.

articles.headline: India Orders Tougher Surveillance on Packaged Water
articles.brief: Indian authorities have ordered strict surveillance measures for packaged water, with regulatory scrutiny expected to cover major multinational beverage giants including PepsiCo and Coca-Cola.

articles.headline: BP Transfers Finance Operations Staff to Wipro
articles.brief: Energy giant BP has transferred 3,000 finance operations staff members to Indian artificial intelligence and IT services firm Wipro as part of a significant operational outsourcing agreement.

articles.headline: India Renews Push for Delimitation and Women's Quota
articles.brief: The Indian government is convening a special session of Parliament to renew its legislative push for tying delimitation bills to establishing a substantial women's quota in the Lok Sabha.

articles.headline: Meta Battles Political Storm in India Over Legal Actions
articles.brief: Social media giant Meta is facing severe political turbulence in India after the country's Congress party initiated lawsuits and staged public protests against the company's platform policies.

articles.headline: Kuwait Blames Iran for Drone Strike Killing Workers
articles.brief: A deadly drone strike on a vital facility in Kuwait has killed two Italian workers and injured two others, with the Gulf nation officially blaming Iran for the military provocation.

articles.headline: Powerful Thanksgiving Storm Batters US East Coast
articles.brief: A severe Thanksgiving storm has swept across the US East Coast, leaving close to a million homes without power, triggering severe coastal flooding, and severely disrupting holiday travel.

articles.headline: Ben Stokes Blasts Cricket Australia Over Sandpapergate
articles.brief: England Test captain Ben Stokes has slammed Cricket Australia's leadership for their handling of the 2018 ball-tampering scandal, demanding closure on the long-running controversy.

articles.headline: NHS Warns of Severe Flu Surge Across UK Hospitals
articles.brief: UK health officials have issued urgent warnings regarding a massive spike in influenza cases, urging vulnerable populations to secure vaccinations immediately as hospital admissions surge.
